narrative.intro: MVM has $234M in contract obligations in FY2026 to date. MVM received 6 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $39.1M, and obligations are up 26.0% year over year. Fiscal-year obligations show $497M in FY21, $769M in FY22, $303M in FY23, $344M in FY24, $186M in FY25, and $234M in FY26. The Department of Homeland Security is the top listed buyer for FY2026 to date. Security Guards and Patrol Services is the top listed NAICS market for FY2026 to date. All current-year totals are partial and cover fiscal year to date, and the note clarifies that some tables report award values as total contract values while other figures are contract obligations.

sections.heading: What is MVM’s fiscal-year performance?
sections.body: MVM has $234M in obligations in FY2026 to date, up 26.0% year over year. MVM received 6 awards in the current fiscal year, with an average award size of $39.1M. Fiscal-year obligations by year are: FY21 $497M, FY22 $769M, FY23 $303M, FY24 $344M, FY25 $186M, and FY26 $234M. Current-year totals are partial and cover fiscal year to date.

sections.heading: Who are MVM’s top customers and what markets do they buy?
sections.body: The Department of Homeland Security is the top buying agency for FY2026 to date, accounting for $234M in obligations. The Department of Health and Human Services is also listed among FY2026 buyers. Security Guards and Patrol Services is the top NAICS market at $234M, and Emergency and Other Relief Services is also listed for FY2026 to date. Some tables report award values as total contract values while other figures are contract obligations.
